title: Funding-Lag Days by Community — Builder Extended Rate Lock Extensions
content:
Two Calloway communities carry a funding lag that is counted when a Builder Extended Rate Lock is extended toward closing.

**Rule.** Where the community on the Home Purchase Agreement the lock finances is Sierra Vista Ranch, 3 days are added to the days to cover; where it is Mesquite Trails, 2 days are added; any other community adds none. The days to cover with these days added are what is rounded up to whole increments.

| Community on the Home Purchase Agreement | Days added to the days to cover |
|---|---|
| Sierra Vista Ranch | 3 |
| Mesquite Trails | 2 |
| any other community | 0 |

The community is read from the Home Purchase Agreement record of the agreement the lock finances.

## Example (hypothetical inputs)

A lock with 12 days to cover, on 7-day increments: in Sierra Vista Ranch the days to cover become 15, needing 3 increments; in Mesquite Trails they become 14, needing 2; in any other community they stay 12, needing 2.
